description: This source file defines a unit test builder class 'BasketBuilder' used to create and configure instances of the 'Basket' class for testing purposes. It utilizes the NSubstitute mocking framework to simulate 'Basket' objects with preset properties and behaviors.

classes.name: BasketBuilder
classes.description: A test utility class for constructing 'Basket' objects with different states, such as empty or with items, for unit testing.

methods.name: WithNoItems
methods.description: Creates a mock 'Basket' with no items and returns it.

methods.name: WithOneBasketItem
methods.description: Creates a mock 'Basket' with a single item added and returns it.
